  cross-brace connection gusset. The FS-50 gusset had a single weld on the

  FP-50-S. Do not use the FS-50X pin (FP-50X-S) in an FS-50 frame; the pin
  shoulder is 1/16 in thicker and will not seat properly.

Winter 2024 Addendum — Cold-Weather Accessories & Maintenance Guidelines
Issued: 01/15/2024

This addendum supplements the main Firewatch Scaffolding Co. specification binder. It
covers cold-weather accessories introduced for the 2024 season and updates the required
maintenance intervals for scaffold components that are exposed to freeze-thaw cycles,
road salt, or prolonged sub-freezing temperatures. All load ratings are static vertical
ratings unless otherwise noted. Controlled revisions are current as of the issue date
above.

---

**CW-1 Cold-Weather Platform Cover**

| Specification | Value |
|---------------|-------|
| Model | CW-1 |
| Material | 18 oz vinyl-coated polyester, sewn seams, grommets at 12 in centers |
| Size | 6 ft x 10 ft, fits FS-50X platform |
| Fastening | 12 bungee cords, included; wind-rated to 35 mph sustained |
| Load Rating | Not a working platform. Snow/ice load only, max 10 lbs/sq ft. |
| Weight | 9.4 lbs |
| Operating Temp | -20°F to 120°F |
| Revision Date | 01/15/2024 |
| Status | Current controlled revision. |

**Notes:**
- The CW-1 is a debris and snow cover only. It is not rated for personnel, material
  storage, or any live load. Do not use the cover as a catch platform.
- Grommets must be tied off at every corner and at the midpoint of each long edge.
  Bungee cords are rated at 25 lbs each and are intended for tension only, not for
  securing the cover against lifting winds above 35 mph.
- If snow accumulates to more than 6 in depth, brush the cover clear before further
  snowfall. Do not use metal shovels on the cover; use a broom or plastic scoop.
- Covers that show cracked stitching, torn vinyl, or missing grommets are to be
  pulled from service and returned to the tool crib with a red tag.

---

**CW-2 Wind Screen Panel (Pair)**

| Specification | Value |
|---------------|-------|
| Model | CW-2 |
| Material | 10 oz polyethylene mesh, 1/8 in openings, with reinforced hem |
| Size | 6 ft x 6 ft per panel; sold as a pair |
| Attachment | Zip ties or wire ties, max 18 in spacing |
| Wind Rating | Effective up to 45 mph; must be removed above that |
| Weight | 3.1 lbs per panel |
| Revision Date | 01/15/2024 |
| Status | Current controlled revision. |

**Notes:**
- The CW-2 is intended to reduce wind chill on the working platform. It does not
  change the load rating of the scaffold and must never be used to support material.
- Panels are installed on the windward side of the scaffold only. Do not wrap panels
  around the entire structure, as this can create a sail effect and overload the
  tie-in points.
- Zip ties should be cut flush. Do not leave sharp tails that could snag clothing.
- After use, panels must be dry before folding. Store in the provided canvas bag.

---

**CW-3 Frame Leg Heater Blanket**

| Specification | Value |
|---------------|-------|
| Model | CW-3 |
| Material | Silicone-impregnated fiberglass, 120V, 200W |
| Size | 12 in x 24 in, wraps around FS-50X leg |
| Control | Built-in thermostat, 40°F on / 60°F off |
| Cord | 6 ft, GFCI plug |
| Load Rating | Not load-bearing. Heating element only. |
| Weight | 2.8 lbs |
| Revision Date | 01/15/2024 |
| Status | Current controlled revision. |

**Notes:**
- The CW-3 is for use on base plates and leveling screws to prevent ice build-up
  that can freeze the jam nut. It is not for use on the platform or on any
  structural connection.
- Connect only to a GFCI-protected circuit. Do not daisy-chain multiple blankets.
- Inspect the cord and plug before each use. Any cracked insulation or exposed wire
  is a do-not-use condition.
- The thermostat is not adjustable. Do not bypass it. Never cover the blanket with
  tarps or insulation; the blanket must be able to shed heat.
- Allow the blanket to cool for 15 minutes before removing.
